notes: Starting cards as posted under [7]: the Watto objective (No Money, No Parts, No Deal!), Watto's Junkyard, Mos Espa, Prepared Defenses, Wipe Them Out, All Of Them, Allegations Of Corruption ('new grabber') and Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans; these count toward the 60.
The machine draft mis-parsed the bracketed section counts ([7], [16], [4], [5], [3], [25]) as cards and dropped quantities; the list was rebuilt from the post.
Posted 'Allegations of curoption(new grabber)' dested the Coruscant Effect Allegations Of Corruption (the Reflections III shield came later).

Posted 'epp vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber (Enhanced Premiere); 'tat maul' Darth Maul (Tatooine set); 'dr.e and ponda' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'zuckuss in boat' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'bosk in bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth.

Posted 'bridge' dested Blockade Flagship: Bridge (the Coruscant-era Dark bridge site); 'death star db' Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'hoth war room' the Dark Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room).
Posted 'new executer' dested Flagship Executor (the Death Star II printing, newer than the Dagobah Executor).
Posted 'ychforever' dested the plain Death Star II Effect You Cannot Hide Forever (no combo named, unlike the 'omni box and it's worse' and 'their is no try and opressive' combos).
Posted 'lost in the wilderness' is printed as written: Lost In The Wilderness is a Light Side card and has no Dark counterpart.
